title: Route (L2) — an individual therapeutic approach
_role: Extends research-object with the full lifecycle the brief requires. Every RT-* validates against this. A route missing any required field fails the checker -- there are no vague states.

strategy.description: Exactly one L1 family. Every route lands in exactly one; the checker enforces both directions, so a family that lists a route the route does not claim is an error.

grade.description: The route's standing. This registry ASSERTS no grade -- it records which file owns it.

rationale.description: The scientific reason to believe this could work, stated so a reader can disagree with it. Not a summary of activity.

supporting_evidence.description: What the rationale actually rests on. May be empty ONLY for a route at maturity `concept`, and the checker enforces that -- a route claiming computed results with no evidence is the exact defect the registry exists to catch.

strength.description: `class_inherited` and `surrogate` are how a plausible-looking case gets built out of measurements that were never taken on this disease. Naming the strength is what keeps that visible.

remaining_unknowns.description: REQUIRED and never empty. A route with no stated unknowns has not been analysed; it has been advocated for.

required_validation.description: What would have to be shown for this route's central claim to stand, whether or not it is currently possible.

instrument.description: V* id, or empty when nothing built serves it.

readiness.description: What this route could become RIGHT NOW. If it cannot reach a given output, the remaining fields say what is missing -- so 'not publishable yet' is a work item, never a dead end.

attainable_today.description: Ordered but NOT a ladder: experimental_proposal is not 'better than' journal_submission -- they are different outputs and a route can be ready for one and not the other.

why_not_higher.description: REQUIRED when attainable_today is below journal_submission.

timing.description: The wait equation. Not every project should begin now, and a delay is only defensible when the reasoning is written down and attached to a monitored condition.

six_month_delta.description: Would six months materially improve the odds, and why?

two_year_delta.description: Would two years fundamentally change feasibility?

automation_outlook.description: How much of this work is plausibly automated by future agents, and which part is not.

revisit_trigger.description: REQUIRED unless recommendation is pursue_now. This is what turns 'later' from a feeling into a monitored condition with an owner.

recommends_compute.description: Compute is recommended only when reasoning is genuinely the exhausted resource. See compute_case.

compute_case.description: REQUIRED when recommends_compute is true. Makes 'push reasoning as far as it goes before spending' a structural constraint rather than advice -- which matters because this program is self-funded.

why.description: Why compute, and not more thinking.

expected_value.description: What decision changes depending on the answer. A run whose every outcome leads to the same next step buys nothing.

resources.description: What it needs. Cost POINTS at the pricing home; it is never typed here.

decision_criteria.description: Stated BEFORE the run: which outcomes mean go, stop, or redirect.

reasoning_exhausted.description: Which non-compute avenues have actually been worked. The checker refuses a compute recommendation with an empty list.

closure_kind.description: Inherited unchanged from the existing registry. `definitional` and `arithmetic_over_fixed_fact` are PERMANENT and may carry no revival trigger. `instrument_limit` is the most revivable kind and is where most of this program's failures sit.

blockers_retired.description: Blockers this route ANSWERS. A route that retires a widely inherited blocker is the portfolio's hedge against it, and is worth more than its own grade suggests.

support.description: An instrument whose known-answer control FAILED, or that has NO control, may never appear here. Those are different facts and neither is support.
